<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="xQz5ads6H8aCEFkS1FIS"> <mxGraphModel dx="2167" dy="1189" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="1"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 autonumber
 actor Candidate as User/Candidate
 participant FE as Next.js Frontend
 participant NextServer as Next.js API Server
 participant PythonAPI as FastAPI Backend (api.py)
 participant Ollama as Local Ollama (gemma3:4b)
 participant Gemini as Gemini Cloud (Fallback)
 participant DB as Firestore DB

 Candidate->>FE: Uploads Resume PDF
 FE->>NextServer: POST /api/resume/upload (multipart/form-data)
 NextServer->>PythonAPI: Forward PDF payload to /resume/parse
 
 Note over PythonAPI: Run ResumeParser (Extract plain text)
 
 %% Parallel Ollama requests
 par ATS Score Calculation
 PythonAPI->>Ollama: POST /api/generate (ATS evaluation prompt)
 Ollama-->>PythonAPI: Return ATS ratings & feedback
 and Claim verification Questions
 PythonAPI->>Ollama: POST /api/generate (Claims extraction prompt)
 Ollama-->>PythonAPI: Return questions & expected keywords
 and Optimization Tips
 PythonAPI->>Ollama: POST /api/generate (Improvement suggestions prompt)
 Ollama-->>PythonAPI: Return recommendations text
 end
 
 Note over PythonAPI: Aggregate & parse output strings into JSON

 alt Parsing fails / Ollama offline
 PythonAPI->>PythonAPI: Apply local JSON repair utility
 alt Repair fails
 PythonAPI->>Gemini: POST generateContent (Call Gemini Cloud API)
 Gemini-->>PythonAPI: Return formatted JSON payload
 end
 end

 PythonAPI-->>NextServer: Return combined analysis JSON
 NextServer->>DB: Save Parsed Resume & Scores to Firestore (User ID ref)
 NextServer-->>FE: Return 200 OK (Analysis payload)
 FE-->>Candidate: Display ATS Dashboard, Recommendations & Claim Questions
",
 "config": null
